name: Confidential Meeting Notes
description: Notes for any confidential meeting, capturing discussion, decisions, and next steps without identifying participants.

sections.title: Meeting Summary
sections.instruction: Briefly summarize the purpose, main topics, and outcomes of the meeting. Refer to people by non-identifying roles or as participants; do not include personal names or identifying details.

sections.title: Discussion Highlights
sections.instruction: Summarize the main ideas, perspectives, concerns, and information shared. Preserve important differences of opinion without identifying who said what.

sections.title: Decisions and Agreements
sections.instruction: List decisions and agreements explicitly reached. Distinguish confirmed outcomes from proposals; do not invent agreement.

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: List unresolved questions, concerns, and topics that need further discussion.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List agreed actions, any non-identifying responsible roles, and timing only when explicitly discussed. If responsibility is unclear, say it is unspecified. Do not invent owners, deadlines, or transcript references.
